clauses.label: Section 1.
clauses.text:
Section 1. S ta tu to ry  P a y  S y s t e m s . Pursuant to the provisions of subchapter I of  
chapter 53 of title 5 of the United States Code, the rates of b asic pay and  
salaries are adjusted, as set forth at the schedules attached hereto and made a  
part hereof, for the following statutory pay systems:

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text: (a) The General Schedule (5 U.S.C. 5332(a)) at Schedule 1;

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text: (b) The Foreign Service Schedule (22 U.S.C. 3963) at Schedule 2; and

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) The schedules for the Department of Medicine and Surgery, V eterans’  
Administration (38 U.S.C. 4107) at Schedule 3.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. S e n io r  E x e c u t iv e  S e r v ic e . Pursuant to the provisions of section 5382 of  
title 5 of the United States Code, the rates of basic pay are adjusted, as set  
forth at Schedule 4 attached hereto and m ade a part hereof, for members of  
the Senior Executive Service.

clauses.label: Sec. 3.
clauses.text:
Sec. 3. E x e c u t iv e  S a la r ie s . The Executive Salary Cost-of-Living Adjustment  
A ct (Public Law  94-82; 89 Stat. 419) provides for adjustments in rates of pay  
and salaries as set forth at the schedules attached hereto and made a part  
hereof, for the following:

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text:
(a) The Vice President (3 U.S.C. 104) and the Executive Schedule (5 U.S.C.  
5312-5316) at Schedule 5;

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text: (b) Congressional Salaries (2 U.S.C. 31) at Schedule 6; and

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text: (c) Judicial Salaries (28 U.S.C. 5, 44(d), 1 3 5 ,153(a), 172(b), and 252) at Schedule

clauses.label: Sec. 4.
clauses.text:
Sec. 4. P a y  a n d  A llo w a n c e s  f o r  M e m b e r s  o f  th e  U n ifo rm e d  S e r v ic e s . Pursuant  
to the provisions of Section 601 of Public Law  98-525, the rates of monthly  
basic pay (37 U.S.C. 203(a)), the rates of basic allow ances for subsistence (37  
U.S.C. 402), and the rates of basic allow ance for quarters (37 U.S.C. 403(a)) are  
adjusted, as set forth at Schedule 8 attached hereto and m ade a part hereof,  
for members of the uniformed services.

clauses.label: Sec. 5.
clauses.text:
Sec. 5. E ffe c tiv e  D ate. The adjustments in rates of monthly basic pay a n d  
allow ances for subsistence and quarters for members of the uniformed s e r v ­
ices, and all other adjustments of salary or rates of basic pay provided for 
herein, shall be effective on the first day of the first applicable pay p e r io d  
beginning on or after January 1,1985.

clauses.label: Sec. 6.
clauses.text:
Sec. 6. Executive Order No. 12456 of December 30, 1983, as amended, is  
superseded.

The President Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay and Allowances
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and law s of the 
United States of A m erica, it is hereby ordered as follow s:
Section 1. In accord ance with the Supplem ental Appropriations Act, 1985

zation A ct, 1986 (Public Law  99-145)—

Federal Register /  Vol. 52, No. 3 /  Tuesday, January 6 ,1 9 8 7  /  Presidential Documents 505
Presidential Documents
Executive Order 12578 of D ecem ber 31, I9 6 0
Adjustm ents of C ertain R ates of Pay and A llow ances
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and laws of the  
United States of America, including section 144 of Public Law 99-500 and 
section 144 of Public Law 99-591» it is hereby ordered as follows:
Section 1. Statutory Pay Systems. The rates of basic pay and salaries of the  
following statutory pay systems are adjusted as set forth on the schedules  
attached hereto and made a part hereof:
(a) The General Schedule (5 U.S.C. 5332(a)) at Schedule 1;
(b) The Foreign Service Schedule (22 U.S.C. 3963) a t Schedule 2r and
(c) The schedules for the Department of Medicine and Surgery, V eterans  
Adm inistration (38 U.S.C. 4107} at Schedule 3.
Sec. 2. Senior Executive Service. Pursuant to the provisions of section 5382 of  
title 5, United States Code, die rates of b asic pay for members o f the Senior  
Executive Service are adjusted as set forth on Schedule 4 attached hereto and  
m ade a part hereof.
Sec. 3. Executive Salaries. Pursuant to the Executive Salary Cost-of-Living  
Adjustm ent A ct (Public Law  94-82; 89 Stat. 419), die rates of pay and salaries  
are adjusted for the following offices and positions a s set forth on the

Sec. 3. E x e c u t iv e  S a la r ie s . The Executive Salary Cost-of-Living Adjustment  
A ct (Public Law  94-82; 89 Stat. 419) provides for adjustments in rates of pay  
and salaries as set forth at the schedules attached hereto and made a part  
hereof, for the following:

CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec3-a.label: (a)
CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec3-a.text:
(a) The Vice President (3 U.S.C. 104) and the Executive Schedule (5 U.S.C.  
5312-5316) at Schedule 5;

CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec3-b.label: (b)
CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec3-b.text: (b) Congressional Salaries (2 U.S.C. 31) at Schedule 6; and

CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec3-c.label: (c)
CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec3-c.text: (c) Judicial Salaries (28 U.S.C. 5, 44(d), 1 3 5 ,153(a), 172(b), and 252) at Schedule

CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec4.label: Sec. 4.
CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec4.text:
Sec. 4. P a y  a n d  A llo w a n c e s  f o r  M e m b e r s  o f  th e  U n ifo rm e d  S e r v ic e s . Pursuant  
to the provisions of Section 601 of Public Law  98-525, the rates of monthly  
basic pay (37 U.S.C. 203(a)), the rates of basic allow ances for subsistence (37  
U.S.C. 402), and the rates of basic allow ance for quarters (37 U.S.C. 403(a)) are  
adjusted, as set forth at Schedule 8 attached hereto and m ade a part hereof,  
for members of the uniformed services.

CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec5.label: Sec. 5.
CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec5.text:
Sec. 5. E ffe c tiv e  D ate. The adjustments in rates of monthly basic pay a n d  
allow ances for subsistence and quarters for members of the uniformed s e r v ­
ices, and all other adjustments of salary or rates of basic pay provided for 
herein, shall be effective on the first day of the first applicable pay p e r io d

CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec6.label: Sec. 6.
CLAUSES:EO:12496#sec6.text:
Sec. 6. Executive Order No. 12456 of December 30, 1983, as amended, is  
superseded.
